question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 11 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 26 hours and pipe C can fill the same tank in 12 hours. The time taken by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is::
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(11, 26, 12) = 1716 units.

Efficiency of Pipe A = 1716 ÷ 11 = 156 units/hour.

Efficiency of Pipe B = 1716 ÷ 26 = 66 units/hour.

Efficiency of Pipe C = 1716 ÷ 12 = 143 units/hour.

Total efficiency = 156 + 66 + 143 = 365 units/hour.

Time taken = Total work ÷ Total efficiency = 1716 ÷ 365 = 4 ²⁵⁶/₃₆₅ hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 ²⁵⁶/₃₆₅ hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A = 11 hours

Time taken by Pipe B = 26 hours

Time taken by Pipe C = 12 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total efficiency of A, B, and C = 156 + 66 + 143 = 365 units/hour

⇒ Time taken by all three pipes together = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 1716 ÷ 365

⇒ Time taken = 4 ²⁵⁶/₃₆₅ hours

**∴ The correct answer is 4 ²⁵⁶/₃₆₅ hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inlet vs Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills the tank and its work is considered positive. An outlet pipe empties the tank and its work is considered negative.

Combined Efficiency Method

When multiple pipes operate together, their net rate of filling or emptying is the algebraic sum of their individual efficiencies: Net Efficiency = Σ(Inlet Efficiencies) − Σ(Outlet Efficiencies).

Work Capacity & Volume

If the flow rate (e.g., liters per minute) of a pipe is given, the total capacity of the tank can be found by multiplying the flow rate by the total time taken by that pipe to independently fill the tank.
